tenant-administration.jobRelevance: Supports user, group, license, domain, and tenant-review tasks commonly assigned to Microsoft 365 support administrators.

entra-id.jobRelevance: Supports identity inventory, group membership, directory-role awareness, device review, and audit-triage responsibilities.

intune.jobRelevance: Shows how an administrator records an endpoint-management validation attempt and preserves the access or licensing boundary instead of overstating the result.

exchange-online.jobRelevance: Supports bounded Exchange Online group review, admin-center navigation, and connection-troubleshooting documentation.

sharepoint.jobRelevance: Demonstrates documentation governance, export preservation, content cataloging, integrity review, and public-safe navigation for a SharePoint-based knowledge collection.

teams.jobRelevance: Supports collaboration-service documentation and Microsoft 365 group or Teams review without claiming ownership of a live organizational environment.

security-compliance.jobRelevance: Supports Conditional Access, authentication-policy, named-location, security-default, and targeted-group review tasks.

applications.jobRelevance: Supports app-registration, enterprise-application, service-principal, and delegated-permission inventory review.

automation.jobRelevance: Supports repeatable read-only evidence collection, structured export, integrity indexing, and claim-governance workflows.

m365-tenant-review.claimText: Reviewed organization, tenant, domain, and subscription records from a personal Microsoft 365 tenant.
m365-tenant-review.limitations: Does not prove production or client tenant ownership.

m365-domain-review.claimText: Reviewed verified-domain records and custom-domain visibility.
m365-domain-review.limitations: Does not prove production DNS or domain-program ownership.

m365-license-review.claimText: Reviewed subscribed SKU, service-plan, and user license-state records.
m365-license-review.limitations: Does not prove procurement, budget, or enterprise licensing ownership.

m365-admin-center-navigation.claimText: Navigated Microsoft 365 admin-center areas for tenant, domain, license, user, and group review.
m365-admin-center-navigation.scope: Browser screenshots from a personal tenant.
m365-admin-center-navigation.limitations: Screenshots do not prove ongoing production administration.

m365-user-group-review.claimText: Reviewed users, groups, and group-membership exports.
m365-user-group-review.limitations: Does not prove workforce lifecycle ownership at scale.

m365-role-review.claimText: Reviewed directory roles and role-assignment records.
m365-role-review.limitations: Does not prove production privileged-access program ownership.

m365-device-review.limitations: Does not prove Intune fleet management.

m365-activity-review.claimText: Reviewed exported sign-in and directory-audit records.
m365-activity-review.limitations: Does not prove SOC ownership or enterprise detection coverage.

m365-intune-validation-attempt.claimText: Documented an Intune managed-device validation attempt and the access or licensing boundary.
m365-intune-validation-attempt.limitations: Does not prove enrolled-device or compliance-policy administration.

m365-exchange-group-review.claimText: Reviewed Exchange admin-center Microsoft 365 group evidence and an exported group list.
m365-exchange-group-review.limitations: Does not prove production mail-flow ownership.

m365-exchange-connection-documentation.claimText: Documented an Exchange Online PowerShell connection attempt and troubleshooting context.
m365-exchange-connection-documentation.limitations: Does not prove successful production Exchange automation.

m365-sharepoint-preservation.claimText: Preserved and hash-verified the indexed SharePoint export collection at stable public paths.
m365-sharepoint-preservation.limitations: Does not prove a live SharePoint service or current tenant state.

m365-documentation-governance.claimText: Created inventory, hash, duplicate, provenance, and technology-relationship records for Microsoft 365 documentation.
m365-documentation-governance.limitations: Integrity records do not establish technical correctness beyond captured files.

m365-teams-group-review.claimText: Reviewed Microsoft 365 Teams or group visibility through portal evidence and preserved documentation.
m365-teams-group-review.limitations: Does not prove live Teams service ownership.

m365-collaboration-documentation.claimText: Preserved Teams, SharePoint, OneDrive, and collaboration setup documentation.
m365-collaboration-documentation.limitations: Documentation does not prove exercised administrative behavior.

m365-conditional-access-review.claimText: Reviewed exported Conditional Access policy and named-location records.
m365-conditional-access-review.limitations: Does not prove organization-wide enforcement or security assurance.

m365-authentication-policy-review.claimText: Reviewed authentication-method and authorization or security-default policy state.
m365-authentication-policy-review.limitations: Does not prove production security-program ownership.

m365-security-group-targeting.claimText: Reviewed the security group and membership used for legacy-auth policy targeting.
m365-security-group-targeting.limitations: Does not prove enterprise-wide enforcement outcomes.

m365-application-review.claimText: Reviewed app-registration and enterprise-application inventory records.
m365-application-review.limitations: Does not prove application development or production ownership.

m365-service-principal-review.claimText: Reviewed service-principal inventory records for governance awareness.
m365-service-principal-review.limitations: Does not prove remediation or consent-program ownership.

m365-oauth-grant-review.limitations: Does not prove enterprise consent governance ownership.

m365-graph-evidence-capture.claimText: Performed read-only Microsoft Graph PowerShell evidence capture for a personal tenant.
m365-graph-evidence-capture.limitations: Does not prove client or production tenant administration.

m365-integrity-indexing.claimText: Maintained SHA-256 inventories and manifests for Microsoft 365 evidence review.
m365-integrity-indexing.limitations: Hashes are not a tamper-proof guarantee.

m365-claim-governance.claimText: Mapped public Microsoft 365 claims to reviewable artifacts and explicit limitations.
m365-claim-governance.limitations: The map does not upgrade documentation into behavior testing.
